title: Effects
description: data/effects.json, and the workspace's effects collection: the named effect library, keyed by id. Items, Tokens, perks and enemy moves hold references into it (effects: [{ effectId, scale }]). Loaded by src/config/registries/effectRegistry.js; authored in cms/src/components/editors/EffectEditor.jsx. Keys not listed here are reported as warnings (unknown keys), not errors.

id.description: effect_ followed by the slugged name while autoSyncId holds; renaming repoints every bearer.

name.description: Shown as the effect's title, with a numeral for the bearer's scale (effectLibrary.js effectTitle).

autoSyncId.description: CMS only: true makes the id follow the name.

status.description: It is a status effect that lands in a fight (src/systems/effects/effectLibrary.js statusBlockOf; LiveEffects.js applyStatus).

stacks.description: How many copies stack (MAX_STATUS_STACKS 5); 1 does not stack.

ticks.description: How long it lasts in ticks; 0 is the whole fight.

statements.description: What it does, in the Rules grammar; ContentAudit refuses an entry with none.
